source:
Key to conifers
A. Needles in sheathed bundles ........ Pinus
AA. Needles solitary
    B. Needles on woody pegs ........ Picea
    BB. Needles leaving circular scars ........ Abies
why: A/AA 与 B/BB 各成一对，子层为隐式跳转。字母惯例据 Rogers《Trees Every Child Should Know》附录 A Key to Needle-leaved Evergreens，https://www.gutenberg.org/files/44186/44186-h/44186-h.htm 。
